heroIntro: An independent production company in Los Angeles. We make films that sit with a question longer than is comfortable.
aboutHeadline: Aporia: the moment a question has no easy way out.
aboutShort: Aporia Films was founded by brothers Andy and Javi Arango to develop and produce character-driven features, shorts and documentaries. We work with first-time and established filmmakers who have a point of view and the patience to earn it.
aboutLong: Aporia Films started with two brothers and a shared conviction that the best stories are the ones that refuse to resolve neatly. We take our name from the Greek for an impasse: the point in an argument where the easy answers run out and the real work begins.

We develop and produce narrative features, shorts and documentaries. We care about films with a clear voice, a specific world and a reason to exist beyond the pitch. We stay close to our filmmakers from the first draft through delivery.

We are based in Los Angeles and work with collaborators wherever the story lives. If you are a writer, director or producer with something you cannot stop thinking about, we would like to hear about it.
projectsIntro: Features, shorts and documentaries in development, in production and released.

founders.name: Andy Arango
founders.title: Founding Partner
founders.bio: Andy leads development and creative. He has worked across writers' rooms and independent features, and is drawn to stories about people who are certain of something they shouldn't be.

founders.name: Javi Arango
founders.title: Founding Partner
founders.bio: Javi leads production and partnerships. He has produced shorts, commercials and documentary work, and is the person who turns a good idea into a schedule, a budget and a finished film.
